Nina (People Ops): Heads up 1: new hire Carlos needs to add an adult sibling as a dependent. He's 28, on long-term disability, lived with Carlos starting 2026-03-01. Is this an eligible "adult disabled dependent" for benefits? What docs and timelines do we need?
Carlos M: He was on Medicaid before moving in. He has an SSDI award letter and a supportive note from his specialist. Im not sure what counts as proof of dependency.
Sasha - Benefits: Welcome Carlos. Adult disabled dependent rules are narrow but doable. We need (1) proof of disability (SSA/SSDI award or equivalent), (2) physician statement confirming functional limitation/need, and (3) evidence of financial dependence or shared household (6-12 months of shared bills, or affidavit if recent move). Because he moved in 3/1, this is likely a qualifying life event (change in household). You have 30 days from the event to submit QLE docs to enroll midyear.
Carlos M: If I submit by the 30-day window, can coverage be retroactive to 3/1?
Sasha - Benefits: Yes, we can request an effective date as of the 1st of the month of the event (3/1) provided we receive acceptable docs proving the date and dependency. We often accept: lease name change, utility bill, move-in affidavit, or Medicaid termination showing date of loss. Retro coverage is discretionary and requires confirmation; payroll will handle premium reconciliation.
SecureUploadBot: Automated note  Use the secure HR portal: https://hr.redwood.com/upload. Do not send PHI over email or slack DMs. Files must be PDF or PNG under 10MB.
Maya (HR Compliance): Small compliance note  redact full SSNs on any uploaded documents. We only need last 4 for verification. Also redact explicit SSI award amounts. We store docs in encrypted records and limit access to Benefits/People Ops only.
Carlos M: Got it. For the physician statement, can it be a brief letter from his neurologist confirming functional limitations and effective date?
Sasha - Benefits: Yes. A concise letter stating the condition affects ability to perform substantial gainful activity, with date and clinician signature, is sufficient. No detailed diagnosis narrative needed.
Nina (People Ops): I'll flag the 30-day deadline in Carlos's HR file and set a follow-up. Carlos, once you upload, mention @Sasha and I'll route to Compliance if needed.
Carlos M: Uploading now via portal. Thanks for the clear checklist.
Sasha - Benefits: Received the docs this morning. Reviewing now. If approved, we'll confirm effective date and notify payroll for retro premium handling. :thumbsup:
